Led by Principal Lawyer Luke Cudmore, our firm has built a team of experienced solicitors committed to achieving results, not just processing cases. Our Aspley office serves families throughout northern Brisbane and North Lakes with aggressive advocacy in divorce litigation, parenting disputes, and property settlement matters. We don't settle for less than what you deserve. Our approach combines thorough legal strategy with relentless pursuit of favourable outcomes - protecting your parental rights, securing your financial future, and defending your interests. FREE 20-minute initial consultation. LGBTQ+ friendly. Women-led practice.

references.title: Martens Legal
references.text: Martens Legal was created with a clear goal: to change the way people experience family law. We saw too many people walking into law firms feeling scared, confused, or shut down — and walking out with more questions than answers. In our eyes, that isn’t good enough. So, we built something different. A place where you’re supported with warmth and clarity. Where legal strategy feels accessible. And where your goals are at the centre of everything. Over the years, we’ve helped hundreds of clients across Brisbane and beyond resolve their legal matters with confidence and calm. And we do it all without the legal ego, intimidation, or overwhelm.
